name: biceps-curl-cable-hammer-rope
title: Biceps Curl: Cable (Hammer, Rope)
primer: Using the rope with the cable machine allows you to isolate the biceps with this version of the Hammer Curl.
steps: Attach a rope to a cable pulley at the bottom of the weight stack.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in.
Grasp the rope with a close neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Lower your arms fully to above your thighs and bending only your elbows, raise the rope to your upper chest.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
tips: This is a good exercise for beginners.
Keep your elbows at your side throughout this exercise.
Do not swing your hips or back during this exercise.
